messages.text: Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: a word from the residents.
The drill struck water: a decision is waiting.
Supply drop landed: colonists 6, earth rations 5, metal 25, brick 10, machinery 3, electronics 3, soil 15.
Kian Reyes is waiting at the office: a word from the residents.
The aquifer on floor 2 is tapped: deep well pumps can draw on it. The showers are cautiously optimistic.
Amara Tanaka is waiting at the office: room demand: a clinic.
Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.
Amara Tanaka is waiting at the office: the doctor's report.

waiting.title: The doctor's report
waiting.text: Amara Tanaka has been keeping an eye on everyone's health. "Meals: people get 0% of what they need. It's costing us 10 health a month. People eat only cooked meals: a galley or kitchen cooks raw food (from farms) or Earth rations into them."

kept.message: The clinic is open. {name} is telling everyone you kept your word.

broken.message: Still no clinic. {name} is telling everyone you broke your word, and handing out bandages.

kept.message: {name} thanks you, for the residents, for fixing it ({what}).

broken.message: {name} says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it ({what}).

outcomes: The aquifer on floor 2 is tapped: deep well pumps can draw on it. The showers are cautiously optimistic.
